title: Open a role report in the run pane

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Parity row 7.7 and gap 11 (docs/orchestrator-parity.md in the s165 worktree). Each role round writes a report file in the run directory, named `ROLE-N.md` or `ROLE-N-attempt-K.md` (`internal/engine/round.go:196-205`), and the run record keeps the file name in `RoleRecord.Report` (`internal/runrec/record.go:64`, set at `internal/engine/round.go:345`; `docs/state.md:16`). No key or command shows one, so the owner opens the file by hand or asks the outer session when a gate FAILs or a role pauses a run.

The pattern exists: the approval card reads a UI render on demand through `run.render` (`internal/daemon/runs.go:1289-1318`, `internal/engine/approval.go:266-285`, `internal/tui/card.go:175-260`). This slice copies that pattern for reports. Slicer has no such command: the reports are ork files, and `slicer find "role report"` finds only s382, which routes a report to the outer session.

Owner decision 2026-10-29 (orchestrator-parity.md, Owner decisions): every gap is a v1.0 slice.

Design (*proposed*): the wire role row gains `report` (the file name). The daemon method `run.report` takes `{run, name}` and returns `{name, text}`. The name must be one the stored record lists; the daemon reads the file with the same guards as renders (a regular file, no link, plain text with control characters dropped, at most 64 KiB, then `(cut: over 64 KiB)`). Rows carry names, never text. In an engine run pane `p` opens the newest report and each further `p` moves to the next older one; after the oldest it returns to the run. `esc` returns to the run. A ledger pane has no reports.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestReadReportReadsAPlainBoundedReport (engine): a report with colour escapes comes back as plain text; one over 64 KiB is cut at a line end with `(cut: over 64 KiB)`.
- TestReadReportRefusesLinksPathsAndOtherFiles (engine): a link, a name with a separator, a directory, a name that does not end in `.md` and a missing file are all `ErrNoReport`; a file swapped for a link after the listing is refused.
- TestRunReportReturnsTheTextOfOneReport (daemon): `run.report` with a name the record lists returns the file's text.
- TestRunReportRefusesWhatTheRecordDoesNotList (daemon): a name that is on disk but not in `roles[].report` (for example `run.json` or `findings-1.md`) is `not_found`, as is an unknown run.
- TestRunRowsCarryReportNamesNotText (daemon): the status wire has `roles[].report` and no report text; a role with no report has none.
- TestPaneReportKeyOpensTheNewestReport (tui): `p` on a run pane with three reports shows `Report 1 of 3: gate-1.md`, asks the daemon once and shows `Loading` until the answer comes; the hint lists `p report` for a run with a report and not for a ledger pane or a run with none.
- TestPaneReportKeyCyclesAndReturnsToTheRun (tui): each `p` moves one report older, the last returns to the run, `esc` returns at once, and no other key acts while a report shows.
- TestPaneReportKeyIsTextInAnAnswerField (tui): with an answer or fix field open, `p` is typed into the field.
- TestPaneReportFailedReadShowsTheError (tui): `Could not read NAME: not_found: ...`; `p` and `esc` still work.
- TestPaneIgnoresALateReportAnswer (tui): an answer for another run, another name or a closed viewer changes nothing.
- TestDaemonReportWire (tui): the connection sends `run.report` with `{run, name}` and maps `not_found` through `actionError`.
- TestPaneReportGoldens (tui): golden of a report at 80x24, colour and monochrome.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
UI slice: UI pass (r14). Tests first (steps 1-2), then code.
1. Engine and daemon tests: `internal/engine/readreport_test.go` (pattern: `renders_test.go:285,340`) and `internal/daemon/report_test.go` (pattern: `render_test.go:52-113`).
2. TUI tests in `internal/tui/report_test.go` (pattern: `renders_test.go:274-300,376`).
3. `internal/engine/report.go`: `ReadReport(runDir, name string) (string, error)` and `ErrNoReport`. Accept only `filepath.Base(name) == name` ending `.md`. Open the file in `runDir` and reuse the guard of `readRender` (`approval.go:285-312`: listing entry and opened file must be the same regular file). Apply `runrec.PlainText` and a `maxReportBytes = 64 << 10` cut.
4. `internal/source/source.go:166`: add `Report string json:"report,omitempty"` (*proposed*) to `EngineRole`; set it in `internal/daemon/runs.go:1215`.
5. `internal/daemon/runs.go`: `MethodRunReport = "run.report"` (*proposed*), a `ReportReply{Name, Text}`, `runReport(p RunAction)` after `runRender` (:1302). Open the record with `Store.Open`, require `p.Name` equal to some `Roles[i].Report`, then `engine.ReadReport(Store.RunDir(p.Run), p.Name)`. Every failure is `not_found`, no wait for the run. Route it in `handleRun` (:1106) and the case list at `handlers.go:113`. Update the `Name` comment on `RunAction` (:63).
6. `internal/daemon/client.go`: `Report(ctx, run, name)` after `Render` (:171-177).
7. New `internal/tui/report.go`: `reportReader` interface and `Daemon.Report` (as `renderReader`, `card.go:186-188`), `reportMsg`, `fetchReport`, `reportArrived`, `reportList()` (the pane run's roles with a report, newest first), `reportKey`, `reportLines`. State in `runPane` (`pane.go:36-50`): `reportName string` and `reports map[string]renderFetch`; key the cache by name.
8. `pane.go:225-280`: `esc` leaves the report; route keys to `reportKey` while one shows (as `renderKey`, `pane.go:273`); `p` acts only when `!m.paneField()` and the run is not a ledger run. In `paneLinesAs` (:405-415) treat a shown report like `viewing` (the card, findings and tree give way, with the dim rule), with the heading `Report N of M: NAME  ROLE round R`.
9. `keys.go`: `Report` binding `p` (*proposed*, free in every context: checked against `keys.go:66-114`), `dropReport = dropRender` at :149, the hint `p report` in the default pane case (:536-552) and `p next report` / `esc back to run` while one shows (:468-478). `model.go:357` routes `reportMsg`.
10. Docs: `dashboard.md:927-940` (new Reports paragraph), `design.md:1073` (`run.report`), `state.md:16`, `CHANGELOG.md`. Goldens: `go test ./internal/tui -update`, review the diff.
Open: (1) Key `p`, with `v` kept for renders (default; the other free letters are b, h, i, m, u, w, z). (2) A shell command `ork report RUN [NAME]` (default: none; the gap says the pane). (3) Check logs (`checks-N.log`, `CheckRecord.Log`) in the same viewer (default: no; they are not role reports). (4) Cap 64 KiB vs the 24 KiB of renders (default 64 KiB; reports are longer).

Owner decisions 2026-10-29 (interactive, review round 1): the p report hint drops right after ctrl+d/u half page, so it outlasts the second scroll form (at 80x24 a running or failed pane shows p report; pgup/pgdown line; esc close pane); the viewer wraps prose lines with wrapText and keeps cutting lines that start with | (table rows).
